text:
ravi: planning to deploy runtime-3.4 + routing tweak to prod tomorrow 02:00 UTC (quiet window). owner: ravi. canary: 5% for 20m, then ramp to 100% if smoke green. feature flag = new-prefetch (off by default).

ravi: quick checklist below — please ack or call blockers. goal is low-risk rollout, no schema migrations.
```
- image: inference/runtime:3.4
- db migrations: none
- feature flags: new-prefetch (off, rollout via flag)
- canary: 5% / 20m
- smoke endpoints: GET /health, POST /v1/generate (sample prompt), POST /v1/embed
- rollback: revert flag + promote runtime:3.3 image; infra runbook ready
- monitoring: perf dashboard, token-rate alert, error-rate alert
- owners: ravi (deploy), sam (infra), tess (sre), josh (qa), maria (product)
```

sam: LGTM. infra changes minimal — routing policy tweak is a config flip on the load-router. will be on call during window.

maria: :thumbsup: product ok. verify latency dashboards post-canary, notify apps-team if anything >100ms p50.

tess: I will run smoke tests at 02:05, 02:25, and 02:45 UTC. setting a 30m post-canary watch window. rollback owner is tess if error-rate spike >3x baseline.

josh: doing quick QA run against staging now, will post short report in 10m. any specific sample prompts you want me to test?

ravi: thanks — josh pls use short gen (<=64 tokens) and embedding call for 512-d vectors. include load spike sim at 50 rps for 2m.

josh: got it, will run and share results.

deploy-bot: Deploy window scheduled for 2167629600 (2026-03-19 02:00:00 UTC). Reminder set for owners 30m before.

sam: one small note — cache invalidation needed for routing table after flip. planned command:
```bash
sudo /usr/local/bin/routerctl reload-config --service inference-router
```
I will execute immediately after canary update.

ravi: good catch. add to runbook step 4.

tess: QA report looks good from josh (staging pass). I also validated alerting thresholds. ready to proceed pending final ack from maria.

maria: ok from product, go ahead. please post canary metrics (latency, errors, tokens/sec) at 02:25UTC.

ravi: all right — final signoffs: sam, tess, josh, maria. anyone object?

sam: no objections.

tess: ready.

josh: ok from QA.

maria: go for it.

ravi: deploy starting at 02:00 UTC. will post status updates in-thread. thanks all. :rocket:
